task: unsupervised trajectory-level anomaly scoring under controlled anomaly construction
contamination_rule: n_anomaly = floor(n_normal * contamination / (1 - contamination)); n_per_type = floor(n_anomaly / 4); four anomaly types

f1_evaluation.name: oracle_top_k
f1_evaluation.interpretation: evaluation-only oracle threshold using the realized injected anomaly count after fitting and scoring

method_config.local_entropy_bin_boundaries: equal-width between the within-ball feature minimum and maximum after view-level standardization

notes: Porto and GeoLife are real trajectory sources, but labels are controlled injections.
The 20-bin histogram is not used for terminal-ball feature weights; it is used only for full-pool view-fusion entropy.
Realized contamination is reported because integer anomaly allocation does not equal exactly 10 percent.
All 30 predefined dataset seeds satisfy the declared counts and trajectory length.
Porto and GeoLife normal pools use exact balanced allocation over non-empty clusters, sampling with replacement only when a cluster is undersized, followed by seed-specific shuffling.
Input paths and focused numerical edge-case checks have been verified.
The sample-size-adaptive histogram implementation is used for all 30 EWGB-TAD dataset-seed jobs.
The result set contains 390 main jobs, 570 component-view-sensitivity jobs, 16 deep-baseline phase-timing jobs, and 30 EWGB-TAD phase-timing jobs.
